# Morpheus test fixtures

Two example models copied unchanged from Morpheus 2.4.1 (`Examples/` at tag `v2.4.1`), under the BSD-3-Clause
licence in `LICENSE-Morpheus.md`:

- `CellSorting_2D.xml` (`Examples/CPM`): cell sorting after Graner and Glazier (1992).
- `AutocrineChemotaxis.xml` (`Examples/Multiscale`): cells secreting and following a chemoattractant field.
